hero.title: Forty years. Same hands, same word.
hero.subtitle: In central Fethiye, at Kasap Orhan's counter. Homemade sucuk, melt-in-mouth lamb, meat chosen fresh each morning. Order on WhatsApp — we'll have it ready.

story.title: One counter, forty years, one word.
story.body: In 1980 Kasap Orhan opened the shutters; today he's still on the same street, with the same care. Fethiye changed, tourists came and went, prices swung — the only constant was the master's hand. Here meat isn't weighed, it's chosen. Sucuk isn't bought in, it's made inside. That's why anyone who tries us once remembers the address.
